spot_price_manipulated.meaning: attacker transiently moved the Uniswap V2 spot tradePrice to an attacker-controlled level before the swap

twap_derived_from_spot.meaning: the time-weighted average reported by validatePrice is derived from the manipulated spot tradePrice rather than historical cumulative price data

protocol_funds_economically_lost.meaning: protocol funds are swapped or rebalanced at manipulated rates causing immediate economic loss in Autonolas buyback/liquidity flows

assumptions: validatePrice is invoked for a subsequent swap or liquidity action after the spot price is manipulated.
The manipulated spot price is transient and attacker-controlled.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete amounts, percentages, or numeric loss figures for the economic loss, so the loss is represented only as a grounded Boolean outcome.
Whether the manipulated-price swap actually executes is stated as conditional (can/may), not observed.

limitations: Economic loss magnitude is not quantified in the report; only the occurrence of loss at manipulated rates is formalized.
The relation uses grounded Boolean observables because the report states qualitative conditions without numeric definitions.
